name: Hive 1.5.10 — audit completion
notes: Completes the security-audit follow-ups. Key rotations/invites now seal to ALL of a member's devices (a second device no longer gets locked out of a new key epoch). Signed account-key succession lets an owner legitimately rotate their key while the dispute protection still fails closed on a forged rotation. The chat 'thinking' lifecycle is now a unit-tested pure contract (a duplicate completion can't collapse a sibling turn). Progressive Markdown while streaming, composer accessibility, a webview CSP, and an Option-C convergence test round it out.
